ui.name: service
ui.label: Service
ui.help: The service name exactly as Checkmk shows it, e.g. `CPU load`, `Memory` or `Filesystem C:/`.

ui.name: metric
ui.label: Metric
ui.help: The Checkmk metric ID, e.g. `util` (CPU utilization; Windows hosts use `util_numcpu_as_max`, which the plugin substitutes automatically), `load1` (CPU load), `mem_used_percent` (Memory) or `fs_used_percent` (Filesystem). Find IDs in Checkmk in the **Service Metrics** entry on the service's details page.
